verdict.rationale: Proton Pass has no built-in automation engine. Its official CLI is documented for retrieving secrets and doing item and vault CRUD inside scripts, deployments, and CI/CD pipelines, so users can build unattended automations around it with external schedulers or pipelines. Missing for 10: native user-configurable background automations or scheduling, documented non-interactive or headless auth for unattended runs, triggers or event hooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous use.
